name: Weather In The Last Days
overview: Scripture reveals that the natural order of weather—seedtime and harvest, cold and heat, summer and winter—will continue as long as the earth remains (Genesis 8:22), yet in the last days, extraordinary signs and upheavals from heaven, including great earthquakes and fearful sights, will occur (Luke 21:11). The coming of the Son of Man will be sudden and unexpected, like the flood of Noah's time (Matthew 24:39), while living waters will flow continually from Jerusalem in both summer and winter, symbolizing divine provision amid these times (Zechariah 14:8). Amid increased knowledge and turmoil, the wise will understand these events as part of God's sovereign plan for purification and judgment in the end times (Daniel 12:4, 10).
